notes.zh: 审阅注：通用的城邦通讯通知。来源有二：首次接触系统在720–1080天后由城邦主动建立通讯（leviathans.97，first_contact_effects.txt:63–71），以及每十年的“城邦通讯扩散”（leviathans.560，on_decade_pulse_country）。读完后按城邦类型打开其问候；灵督城邦（shroud.4199）与冠军熔炉（nomads.155）的问候属于其他故事，此处未连接。
notes.en: Review note: generic enclave contact notice. Two sources: the first-contact system lets an enclave establish communications 720-1080 days later (leviathans.97, first_contact_effects.txt:63-71), and the decade 'communication spread' (leviathans.560, on_decade_pulse_country). Afterwards the enclave's own greeting opens; the Mindwarden (shroud.4199) and Champion's Forge (nomads.155) greetings belong to other stories and are not linked here.
